goal: Put a big line of text on the video that says INSANE CLUTCH so people know what happens.

success.describe: A text element reading INSANE CLUTCH is on the clip (new or the existing placeholder rewritten)

why.data: Text goes with +45.9 export points (same user) but is used in only 5.8% of projects

notes: The default project already has an ENTER TEXT HERE placeholder; rewriting it also meets the goal. The Title chip path is shorter in theory but did not open an editable text field in best-path (check in phase 6 logs).
